label: Puerto Rico: Special Edition
description: Choose roles, develop your island, produce goods and ship them for points. This Special Edition adaptation includes New Buildings, Citizens, Smuggler, Festival and Festival Activities, in one fixed configuration for 2–5 players.
rules:
Choose a role, then all players carry out its action in turn; the player who chose it receives a privilege. Plant estates, recruit workers, construct buildings and produce goods. Sell goods for money or ship them for points. When everyone has chosen their roles, pass the governor marker and begin the next round. Most points from shipping, buildings and bonuses wins.

[Official Special Edition rules (English)](https://awakenrealms.com/images/download/puerto-rico/EN/EN_PR_Rulebook_210x285mm_bleed3mm%20%5B44%20pages%5D.pdf). In-game help is available in English and French.
credits:
Designed by **Andreas Seyfarth**. Based on **Puerto Rico 1897: Special Edition**, published by **Awaken Realms** and **Ravensburger**.

Original vector interface illustrations for this digital adaptation. The private playtest includes the five modules listed above; Achievements and Puertoma are not included.
